This document outlines the
major maintenance procedures 
P1, which must be carried out
every four years as 
indicated by Y4 in the above title block. This pump is used to pumped 
feed water from feed water tank to high pressure heater.

The first draft initiated 
and tested by eng. 
Adel Saad Zaghloul, reviewed by eng. 
Sobhy Abel Halim, 
accepted by eng. 
Mohamed Abd El 
Ghaffar 
general director of 
Alarish PS, revised by EDEPC inspection & quality control eng. Abouda Elbana.

This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
 inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial 
 inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Isolate the 
 circuit breaker of the pump motor.

Disconnect 
 electric terminals of the pump motor.

The pump must 
 be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.

Disconnect the suction & discharge flanges and 
 all oil and water piping including the balancing line

Be sure pump 
 must be completely drainage.
Remove all instruments.

Remove the pump protection guard and 
 insulating cover.
Complete maintenance tool set.

Vibrometer, 
 wooden blocks.
Cleaning fluid, anti seizing paste.
Feeler gauge, dial indicator.
Check discharge quantity and pressure and record them.
Check the vibration level of the pump set complete with motor and record them.
Shut down the pump.
Measure the alignment and record it.
Dismantle the coupling.
Lift the electric motor.

Remove the centering pins (566.05), remove the screws (901.03) dismantle the 
 half upper case (352.02).

Lift the shaft slightly, rotate the half lower bearing (313.02) and the 
 labyrinth seal ring (423.02) inside housing to remove them.

Remove the upper part of bearing and labyrinth by disjunction as it is 
 provided for stop pins that prevent their rotation.
Dismantle the mechanical seal (433.01) but install again flange.

Place the sleeve (18) and the ring in two half (19) in replacement of journal 
 bearing (313.02).
Install the upper support casing (352.02) and lock on the lower one (351.02).
Lock the shaft by action on the screw 20.

Dismantle the lubrication screw pump (632.01) unscrew the screw (901.01), 
 remove the support cover (169.01) and O ring (412.09).
Disconnect the upper half of the support case (352.01).

Dismantle the journal bearing (313.01) both thrust half bearings and labyrinth 
 split ring (423.01) as mentioned before (on the front side).
Straighten the lock washer (931.01), unscrew the bearing nut (923.01).
With draw the locating sleeve (527.01).
Remove the key (940.04) and with draw the locating ring (519.01).
Sling the bearing housing by slightly pulling the lifting ropes.
Remove the bearing housing.
Disconnect the flowing pipe from the seal flange 11.

Loosen the screw 40 and insert the position plates 103 in the housing provided 
 for sleeve 1, lock the screw 40.
Loosen the stop dowel 57.1 and with draw the drive collar 58.

Unscrew the connecting nuts of seal flange and in with draw the complete 
 seal.

Remove the stuffing box positioning pins ( 566.01 ) and the delivery casing 
 set screws.
Disassembly the stuffing box (451.01) and O ring (412.07).

Unscrew the screw (914.06) of the drum tension bush (548.01), with draw the 
 split ring (501.01) and remove it.
Dismantle the space ring and remove O ring (412.1).
With draw the balance drum liner.
With draw the balance drum.

Unscrew four nuts (920.03), remove four tie bolts (905.01), replace them with 
 four threaded bars (12) with washer (11.14) and nuts (13).

Arrange all threaded bars, the four flange (10), insert washer (14) and lock 
 every thing by nuts (13).
Remove all tie bolts as mentioned before.
Lift the delivery casing, remove it carefully from the last stage casing.

Remove the diffuser (177.01) from the delivery casing and remove the O ring 
 gasket (412.04).

Install the plate (1) complete with guide (2) on the base plate, install the 
 support (6) with screw (7) on the tooth of the inter stage casing to be 
 removed (the last one).

Lock the screw (9), adjust the height of inter mediate casing by acting on 
 screw (7).

Unloose the screw (13), remove the plate (10) and place it on the last inter 
 mediate casing, detach it and let it slide on the support guide and remove O- 
 ring (412.05).
Remove the diffuser from inter stage casing.
With draw impeller (last stage).
Remove the key (940.02).
With draw the spacer bush (543.01)
Repeat the method mentioned above to remove all stages.

Mount the mechanical seal flange

Mount the bearing housing lower half without bearing nor labyrinth , screw the 
 nuts (920.02), install the centering pins (566.03) and lock the screw

Install the special tools (18.19), install the half coupling and lock the

Install the equipment for installation of the inter mediate casing.

Mount the key (940.02), fit the first stage impeller adjust the clearance

Mount the diffuser (171.01) on the inter stage casing (113.01) fit the

With the aid of special tools. Sling the inter mediate casing and insert it on 
 the shaft.

Arrange four bolts with washer (11-14) and nuts (13) insert the plate (10) and

Repeat above steps for assembly all stage.
Assemble the balance drum, mount the O-ring (412.10).

Mount the spacer ring (504.01), mount the tension ring (548.01) and fix it by 
 the screws (914.02 , 914.06).
Mount the O ring gasket (412.11) into its seat.
Mount the balance drum liner
Mount the tension ring (515.01), tie the screw (914.02).
House the O ring (412.04)in its seat
Assemble the diffuser (177.01) in the delivery casing.
Mount the delivery casing with the diffuser and the O ring (412.05).
Use four tie bolts with centering bush (546.01) and nut (920.03).

Fit the tie bolts in the suction casing until the longest threaded part goes 
 out from the delivery side.
Mount the centering pin bush and nuts (920.03)
Tighten the tie rod one nut, then on the opposite one.

Unloose the four tie bolts, reset the pump perfectly on the base plate, lock 
 the suction casing on the base plate.
Place the delivery casing on the base plate without locking.
Tighten threads (with torque set 250 kgm.).
House the O ring (412.07 . 412.08).
Assemble the cooling jacket cover (165.01).

Mount the stuffing box complete with O ring (412.06) fix it with the screw 
 without locking.
Mount the taper pins (566.01) to complete screw tightening.
Arrange the rotating parts on the sleeve (1).
Tight the stop dowel (57) gradually.
Insert the flange (11) in the rotating part.

House the plates (103), push the flange (11) against the stuffing box and lock 
 it.
Lock the flange (11), tight the nuts gradually and uniformly.

Mount the bearing housing lower half, screw nuts of the connecting studs 
 without locking (coupling side).

Mount the locating ring (519.01) and thrust bearing plate (384.01), mount the 
 bearing housing lower half (thrust side), without locking the connecting 
 studs.

Move the bearing house down words by acting the centering screw (907.01), 
 mount the lower half guide bearing (313.02).

Lift the bearing house up to contact point of the bearing with the shaft, lean 
 the shaft on the lower half and adjust the clearance (0.05 -0.08 mm).
Lock the connecting nuts of the support diagonally and gradually.
Assemble the half rings of labyrinth seal (423.01).
Mount the four half thrust rings (413.02).

Introduce the locating ring sleeve (527.01), lock washer (931.01) and screw 
 down the bearing nut (923.01).
Assemble the support complete with the cover.
Reinstall the lubrication screw pump.
Mount the insulation cover.
Alignment and positioning.
Pump locking.
Before pump start up the following should be checked:
Oil level.
Cooling circuit open.
Open suction and delivery valve.
Check the direction of rotation of pump.
Temperature of bearing.
Temperature of cooling water.
Any water and oil leakage.
Discharge quantity, pressure (suction, delivery) sides and record them.
Check the vibration level and record it.
Check the balance drum pressure.

Reassembly
Suction Casing
House the O- ring gasket (412.01), assemble the suction casing and

Mount the O ring gasket (412.11) into its seat.
Mount the balance drum liner
Delivery Casing
Mount the tension ring (515.01), tie the screw (914.02).
House the O ring (412.04)in its seat
Assemble the diffuser (177.01) in the delivery casing.
Mount the delivery casing with the diffuser and the O ring (412.05).
Tie Bolts
Use four tie bolts with centering bush (546.01) and nut (920.03).
Fit the tie bolts in the suction casing until the longest threaded part goes 
 out from the delivery side.
Mount the centering pin bush and nuts (920.03)
Tighten the tie rod one nut, then on the opposite one.
Unloose the four tie bolts, reset the pump perfectly on the base plate, lock 
 the suction casing on the base plate.
Place the delivery casing on the base plate without locking.
Tighten threads (with torque set 250 kgm.).
Stuffing Box
House the O ring (412.07 . 412.08).
Assemble the cooling jacket cover (165.01).
Mount the stuffing box complete with O ring (412.06) fix it with the screw 
 without locking.
Mount the taper pins (566.01) to complete screw tightening.
Mechanical Seal (Both 
Sides)
Arrange the rotating parts on the sleeve (1).
Tight the stop dowel (57) gradually.
Insert the flange (11) in the rotating part.
House the plates (103), push the flange (11) against the stuffing box and lock

Lock the flange (11), tight the nuts gradually and uniformly.
Bearing Housing
Mount the bearing housing lower half, screw nuts of the connecting studs

Mount the locating ring (519.01) and thrust bearing plate (384.01), mount the

Introduce the locating ring sleeve (527.01), lock washer (931.01) and screw

Assemble the support complete with the cover.
Reinstall the lubrication screw pump.
Mount the insulation cover.
Alignment and positioning.
Pump locking.
Pump Startup

Oil level.
Cooling circuit open.
Open suction and delivery valve.
Check the direction of rotation of pump.

During Operation
Temperature of bearing.
Temperature of cooling water.
Any water and oil leakage.
